set.body: Only after local-engine failure analysis, evaluate cosine-windowed FFT proposals and optional learned affine/features behind Proposal. The hrf-private FFT is not reusable; add a Gale FFT capability only with a general contract and at least one second consumer. Every proposal must pass the same objective, inverse, and topology gates and must report a no-proposal ablation.
set.title: HalfFlow X: optional FFT and learned coarse proposals
